polls.label: Ipsos Khayabus · all metros · Dec 2025–Jan 2026
polls.geography: All-metro aggregate — no Johannesburg-only cut published
polls.caveat: Face-to-face, registered voters, ~43–49% undecided largely unallocated — the methodological opposite of SRF, and the kindest credible read for the ANC. Applies all-metro numbers to Joburg.
polls.note: ALL-METRO AGGREGATE with no Johannesburg cut published. Scope is 'metro-aggregate' so it is NOT applied as a city poll: eight metros averaged is not a reading of one of them, and using it as one would import Cape Town's DA and eThekwini's MK into Johannesburg.

The only INDEPENDENT pre-election poll published for the 2021 local elections. ActionSA's actual national result was 2.34%, so this was low by a factor of 1.6 -- against a model out by 3 in Johannesburg and 6 in Tshwane. Entered so the conversion in src/polling.py can be scored on a target that has happened.
polls.source: IEC-reported result and poll table, Wikipedia '2021 South African municipal elections'; Ipsos South Africa releases

polls.note: Reported ActionSA 'on course to win Joburg'. It finished THIRD on 16.05%. Recorded WITHOUT numbers and flagged commissioned_by so it is excluded by default: it is the evidence for the exclusion rule, not evidence about the election.

polls.label: Ipsos Khayabus · Johannesburg · September 2026
polls.fieldwork: reported 4 September 2026; fieldwork window not stated in any source reached
polls.geography: City of Johannesburg breakout of a national omnibus (n≈3,600 across nine provinces); CoJ subsample size not stated
polls.caveat: ⛔ THE DA FIGURE IS DISPUTED BETWEEN OUTLETS: Daily Maverick and allAfrica report DA 27, Bloomberg reports DA 28 from the same release; 28 is used here because it is the figure the fuller party breakdown came with. NO SOURCE IN THE CHAIN REACHED IPSOS'S OWN RELEASE — the ANC/DA line comes from secondary reporting (newsroom/2026-09-05.md), the ActionSA/EFF/MK split from Fullview citing the same release (newsroom/2026-09-13.md). The CoJ subsample size and the fieldwork window are unverified. First non-SRF, non-party-internal CoJ read since March, and it swings sharply toward the ANC against every other 2026 CoJ number on file. Admitted to the register on the owner's instruction 2026-09-27 ('add all new polls found'); admission to the REGISTER is not admission to the FORECAST, which is gated by poll_paths and is off.

polls.label: eNCA/MarkData · Johannesburg · August–September 2026
polls.fieldwork: 10 August to 14 September 2026 per eNCA's methodology page and TimesLIVE; eNCA's 11 October explainer gives 10 August to 12 September and the Sunday Times 12 August to 10 September
polls.geography: City of Johannesburg, registered voters who intend to vote; Johannesburg sample of a six-metro survey (6,113 interviews)
polls.caveat: Vote intention, "Who are you planning to vote for in the coming local elections?"; Other 1.0%, no undecided figure published. Method per https://www.enca.com/news/6113-voters-six-metros-inside-markdatas-election-survey: face-to-face interviews in township and lower- and middle-income areas, telephone in higher-income, gated and unsafe areas; weighted to StatsSA population, IEC registration and differential turnout; margin of error 3.08 points at 95%. Three fieldwork windows are published (see fieldwork); the methodology page's is used. Verified at source 2026-10-21 (newsdesk digests of 18 and 21 October could not reach the page). Admission to the register is not admission to the forecast (poll_paths off).

polls.label: News24/SABI · Johannesburg · August–September 2026
polls.fieldwork: 25 August to 17 September 2026 per News24's 4 October report; its 9 October article gives 25 August to 7 September
polls.geography: City of Johannesburg, registered voters; Johannesburg sample of a national survey (5,001 interviews), mainly face-to-face
polls.caveat: Party vote among registered voters as News24 prints it, in whole points; Daily Maverick (6 October) gives DA 29.2, ANC 22.6. Mayoral question, modelled for a 52% turnout, separate: Zille 36, the ANC's candidate 27, Mashaba 13 (News24's summary box calls 36 the DA's share, which is the mayoral figure). Margin of error 3.3 points. Two fieldwork windows are published; the 4 October report's is used. Verified at source through the owner's subscription 2026-10-21. Admission to the register is not admission to the forecast (poll_paths off).
